items.subject: New jobs similar to Impact Development Officer at Kingston University
items.summary: LinkedIn suggested two new relevant vacancies: Youth Engagement & Partnerships Officer at Kensington and Chelsea and Community Impact Manager at Lloyds Bank Foundation; the Community Project Officer listing is a duplicate.
